title: Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund (HMCPF) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cancer-treatment financial assistance channel under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi for eligible economically vulnerable patients.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible poor cancer patients satisfying current income, treatment and institutional requirements under HMCPF/RAN guidelines.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund (HMCPF).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
